forwardEnvelope.sourceDerivation: WGSL15.7.4 and GLSLES3.00sec4.5.1 permit at most2.5ULP for reciprocal/division on this normal denominator domain; use relative5u. A correctly-rounded result may select either adjacent float, so conservatively budget relative2u for each GPU add/multiply. Red/green longest term path is reciprocal5u +multiply2u +two additions4u =11u; cubic Horner has6primitive rounds at2u =12u. Native CPU round-to-nearest/FMA paths have no greater bound. Thus each evaluator is bounded by gamma12*S, gamma12=12u/(1-12u); two errors sum to<=2gamma12*S<32u*S. Source interval monotonic absolute-term bounds establish S<16 over800..12000, so32u*S<2^-15. Fused operations require fewer roundings. Final nonnegative clamp is1-Lipschitz; branch index is exact from storedF32 input; alpha authored1. All intermediates normal or zero in this domain.
